State vector  
|ψ⟩ = 0.5 |↑⟩ + (√3 / 2) |↓⟩  
(|↑⟩ ≡ (1,0)ᵀ, |↓⟩ ≡ (0,1)ᵀ)

Pauli matrices  
σ_z = [[1,0],[0,-1]] , σ_x = [[0,1],[1,0]]

1. Expectation of σ_z  
⟨σ_z⟩ = |0.5|² − |√3/2|² = 0.25 − 0.75 = −0.5

2. Expectation of σ_x  
⟨σ_x⟩ = 2 Re[(0.5)·(√3/2)] = 2·0.5·(√3/2) = 0.8660

3. Expectation of the operator  
⟨10 σ_z + 5 σ_x⟩ = 10(−0.5) + 5(0.8660)  
           = −5 + 4.330 = −0.670 ≈ −0.7 (to one decimal place)

Hence the correct option is (A).

Answer: A
